preconditions.description: The dimensions of the sheet of paper are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in grid)
preconditions.description: Each line of the grid has the same length as the number of columns.

preconditions.expression: all(char in ['#', '.'] for line in grid for char in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid is either '#' or '.'.

preconditions.expression: any(any(char == '#' for char in line) for line in grid)
preconditions.description: There is at least one painted square in the grid.

postconditions.description: The output is either a non-negative integer or -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(any(char == '#' for char in line) for line in grid) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no painted squares, the output is -1.
If the set A has one or zero squares, no deletions are needed.
The output is the minimum number of deletions required to disconnect the set A.
